verdict.rationale: All evidence describes Superset exposing its own MCP server (server-card.json, hosted api.superset.sh/mcp with OAuth) so external agents can control Superset — this is the opposite role from the story, which asks whether a user can plug external MCP servers into Superset so it (or the agents it orchestrates) can use their tools. No evidence shows Superset accepting/consuming third-party MCP server configurations to extend its own or its agents' toolset.
